status: Independent decoder matches all 82 repeat-identical native import/source/preparation cases and three complete native GUI conversions. Three additional tiny-interlaced files retain the native loader failure.
authority: GIF89a defines structural parsing. Untouched original blob decoding and source/preparation bytes govern legacy behavior.
api: Private decodeGif(encoded) returns owned width, height, bgra, hasAlpha and format=gif. No runtime dependencies, native binary, network or browser decoder.
frame: Decode the first image descriptor using its width/height and local palette when present. Logical-screen dimensions and offsets do not expand or composite this raster. Native captures verify fourteen offset/local-palette cases and a separate comment/application-extension case; an animated conversion ignores its distinct blue second frame.
compression: GIF LZW, least-significant bit packing, clear/end codes, dictionary growth to 12 bits, deferred clear, and four-pass interlace. Captures cover minimum sizes2 through8, special next-code expansion, midstream/repeated clears and dictionary saturation with deferred clear.
palette: The image's local table takes precedence over the global table. Graphic-control transparency selects intrinsic hasAlpha only when its index lies inside the active table.
nativeOpacity: Legacy opacity=-1 is cast to Q8 before pixel import, so opaque index255 gets alpha0 even with hasAlpha=false. Transparent palette colors retain RGB. Common source preparation already distinguishes intrinsic metadata from raw alpha; no GIF-only preparation branch.
remaining: Exact native diagnostics, malformed/error routing, nonstandard coding modes, metadata and failure in later animation frames remain unfinished.
interlace: Advance one pass after each completed row, as the original does. For interlaced heights2/3/4 the next pass selects an out-of-image row and the loader throws. Six fresh native calls confirm stage921 C++ exceptions; error context addresses vary and are not pixel expectations.
